construction: small: top-k historical factor scores, optionally calibrated by label swaps for small_similar or replaced by an unaltered M2 row; large: fixed permutation of small labels
coverage_target: theta_star = sum(z) / N, conditional on each fixed binary z
pilot_statistic: mean Brier error to fixed z over last quarter of pilot steps, then across repeats

z_1_source.method: unaltered M2 model answers; large_similar permutes this same vector
